body.p: One day as Tawkxwax was walking by the side of a lagoon he found a piece of leather. He picked it up, looked at it and threw it into the water. Shortly afterwards he decided he wanted the piece of leather but could not find it. He put his hands in the water to feel for it and was stung. He saw that he had been stung by a sting-ray and realized that the piece of leather had changed into a sting-ray.
